narrative.synopsis: Gaia and Uranus produce the Titans, a powerful generation that includes Oceanus, Rhea, and the youngest child Cronus. The birth episode matters because one child already carries the threat of succession.
narrative.openingSituation: Earth and sky have become a divine household capable of producing children.
narrative.centralConflict: A generation powerful enough to inherit the cosmos is born under Uranus’ authority.
narrative.resolution: The Titans stand as a complete sibling group, with Cronus marked as the future danger.
narrative.outcome: The first ruling household now contains the force that will break it.
